name: haunt-alexa
description: Haunt for Alexa+: interactive voice horror stories over a self-hosted MCP server (spec 2025-11-25, Streamable HTTP), an Agent Skill, and a simulated Echo Show / Echo device.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @haunt/views && concurrently -n views,server,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @haunt/views" "npm run dev -w @haunt/server" "npm run dev -w @haunt/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @haunt/views && npm run build -w @haunt/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @firetales/core && npm test -w @haunt/scene-fx && npm test -w @haunt/server && npm test -w @haunt/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/firetales && tsc -p packages/scene-fx && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/views && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.dev:mock: NODE_ENV=development HAUNT_AUTH=mock HAUNT_PROVIDER=mock HAUNT_AGENT=mock HAUNT_TTS=browser HAUNT_PREWRITE=off HAUNT_STORE=file npm run dev
